description: This file is a PHP source code file defining the Api class for the Account module in the Opencart	rash	eam folder. It contains methods related to API login, session management, and IP retrieval.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Represents the Account API model handling login, session creation, and IP management within the Opencart framework.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user by username and key, returning the matching database row if valid.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Creates a new API session record with session ID and IP address, returning the new session ID.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP addresses associated with a particular API ID.
